rule.PASS: Ran and reached its final assertion successfully; a test that did not reach its final assertion is not PASS.
rule.DIVERGED: Ran with an unchanged assertion that failed; record the finding and first failing message.
rule.NOT RUN: Launch, boot or installation failed; record the error without per-scenario claims.
rule.EXISTING: An existing unchanged measurement was run again.

scenarios.name: bind-legacy-repause
steps: Pause with a descriptor binding, then remove only stateBinding from metadata.
Restore in a fresh Worker, answer and pause again with the independent expected binding.
Change unrelated.json from {} to []; refuse unrecoverable with zero traffic and unchanged rows.
Restore original JSON in a fresh Worker; complete with one replay and no repeated capability effect.

predictions.stateBinding: Firefox and WebKit match the seven existing Chromium outcomes.
predictions.legacyRepause: Node and all three browsers bind the second pause, refuse changed JSON without traffic or writes, and complete after rollback.
predictions.threadPool: All three browsers match Node: thread and pool starts raise RuntimeError; the other five probes refuse unsupported with zero requests.
predictions.fanout: Firefox and WebKit match all three goldens and reload with exactly one replay notification.
predictions.additionalAdapters: Pause-capable groups and a Parallel-shaped adapter are considered, not built; both require a shipped-source design.
predictions.order: Scopes count every local journaled call; joins sort by input key order, then local ordinal, independent of arrival order.
predictions.terminalFailures: The first recorded terminal code wins, independent of input order, measured natively.
predictions.realModels: Unmeasured: no model access in this environment.
